pages.text: Before there were temples, before the Ring, before envy divided what once stood together, there were two brothers.$(br2)We were not born of chance. Our existence was a gift from a will greater than either of us could comprehend.
To the Allfather, the Axolotl Absolute, I owe my beginning. Whatever became of us, that truth has never changed.$(br2)And so, I shall begin with my brother.
